text:
Maya (AE): Quick heads-up: Pegasus asked for a POC run this Fri. Requirements: sustained 500 QPS, 2k burst headroom, p99 <= 150ms generation (non-streaming), multi-region (US/EU) failover, BYOK/HSM, SOC2 evidence. They want a 24h soak and a cost ballpark. Who can own schedule/run?

Jamie (Sales SE): I'll run it. Need sample prompt mix and avg token lengths. Proposed plan: smoke -> ramp 0->500 QPS in 30m -> 24h soak -> scheduled 60s 2kQPS bursts every 4h. Test two model variants: rwl-3b and rwl-13b-quant for perf vs cost.

Lee (Infra Ops): We can spin Dedicated pools in us-west1 + eu-west1. Baseline: 4x A100-equiv per region to hit sustained 500 with headroom; autoscale for bursts. BYOK+HSM adds ~24-48h ops work & region constraints.

Jamie (Sales SE): Load runner example (using vegeta):
```bash
cat prompts.json | jq -c '.[] | {input: .prompt}' | vegeta attack -header "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -rate=500 -duration=600s | vegeta report
```
For soak we'll run sustained at 500 QPS across both regions (250 local each) and fire coordination bursts at 2k QPS from us-west runners to avoid cross-region throttling noise.

Anna (Product Eng): To meet p99 tail, prefer 13b-quant + async batching (target batch_size=6). Set max_tokens=128 for consistency. Streaming increases p99; customer opted non-streaming which helps. Enable KV-prefix caching for repeated prefixes.

security-bot: Security questionnaire link: https://redwood.security/pegasus-sq. Required items: SOC2 report, KMS type, BYOK/HSM appendix, data residency, and access control matrix. @Maya please upload NDA & completed SQ.

Maya (AE): Customer confirmed non-streaming and BYOK with HSM. I'll push NDA and prompt samples by Thu EOD. Jamies, can you lock run to Fri 09:00 PT? Lee, can you post infra sizing + line-item cost by tomorrow?

Lee (Infra Ops): Will do. Need exact prompt mix and avg output token size (estimate). If avg output ~80 tokens, cost shifts. Preliminary 24h soak infra cost estimate: ~$1.4k/region infra + ops time. With model mix (70% 3B, 30% 13B-quant) total run cost estimate ~ $3.5k-$4.5k. Detailed breakdown to follow.

Jamie (Sales SE): Tentative runbook: 1) preflight smoke at 07:30 PT, 2) ramp start 09:00 PT, 3) soak 24h, 4) bursts at hh:00 every 4h. I'll post k8s runner manifests and vegeta scripts here. 

Maya (AE): Perfect. I'll confirm final prompt pack and legal upload. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
internal_note: Sales POC coordination: multi-region soak + bursts, BYOK/HSM security asks, vegeta example. Short Slack-style messages.
